answers.why: Midian oppresses Israel, whose people make mountain shelters.
Israel sows crops that invading peoples attack and destroy.
The invaders destroy the country's crops and leave Israel without sustenance.
Impoverished Israel is identified with the children of Israel crying to the LORD.
The God of Israel addresses the people he brought out of Egyptian bondage.
Gideon is commissioned to deliver Israel from Midian's oppression.
Gideon asks how he can deliver Israel from the Midianites.
Gideon locates his clan within the tribe of Manasseh.
Messengers go throughout Manasseh, which musters behind Gideon.
Asher receives Gideon's messengers and joins the assembled fighting forces.
Zebulun receives Gideon's messengers and comes up to join the forces.
Naphtali receives Gideon's messengers and comes up to join the forces.
Gideon asks whether God will deliver Israel through him after the tribes muster.
The fleece is a sign that God will deliver Israel through Gideon.
